rules.instruction: When the description says an activity is repeated until a stated condition is met: Model each attempt followed by a decision; loop back to repeat the activity when the condition is not met, and continue when it is met.
rules.situation: the description says an activity or sequence of activities must be repeated until a stated condition is met

rules.instruction: When the description states a sequence of activities or a conditional step followed by a later activity: Connect the activities and any modeled gateways in the stated order with sequence flows, including every described transition.
rules.situation: the description states an order between activities or gateways, including transitions into or out of a conditional branch or a repeated step

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes an event or activity by its action, actor, object, recipient, or another meaningful qualifier: Label each BPMN element so that it preserves those stated details without substituting a broader or different meaning.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes an activity from similar activities by a stated action, object, or other meaningful qualifier

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity and separately states that its duration or performance is measured: Model the measurement as a distinct activity, and connect it to the measured activity according to the temporal relationship stated in the description.
rules.situation: the description states an activity and separately states that its duration or performance is measured

rules.instruction: When the description gives an activity together with contextual or explanatory details that are not needed to distinguish the activity in its process context: Label the BPMN task with its core action and necessary object, omitting redundant contextual modifiers while preserving details essential to the activity’s meaning.
rules.situation: the description gives an activity together with contextual details that are redundant for identifying the activity in its process context

rules.instruction: When the description states that several activities are all required before a later activity or outcome: Model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize all branches with a parallel gateway before the later activity or outcome.
rules.situation: the description explicitly states that two or more distinct activities happen at the same time
